        }

        /* Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;           /* CRITICAL */
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        /* ALL typography uses clamp() */
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Breakpoints: 700px, 600px, 500px */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* End viewport-base.css */

        /* === BASE === */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* Subtle grid pattern on every slide */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(77,168,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(77,168,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 56px 56px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }
        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-amber);
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.35s ease;
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem);
            z-index: 9998;
            list-style: none;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 5px; height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-dim);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* === SLIDE NUMBER === */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.25rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        /* === SHARED HEADING ELEMENTS === */
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.18;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.28;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .accent-line {
            width: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-amber);
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.65rem) 0;
        }

        /* =============================================
           ANIMATIONS
           ============================================= */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(22px);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.04s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.20s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.36s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.44s; }

        /* Staggered children (grid cards, etc.) */
        .stagger-child {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(18px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(1) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.10s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(2) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.20s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(3) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.30s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(4) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.40s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(5) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.50s; }

        /* Table row stagger */
        .tr-reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-8px);
            transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s ease;
        }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(1) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(2) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.23s; }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(3) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.31s; }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(4) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.39s; }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(5) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.47s; }
        .slide.visible .tr-reveal:nth-child(6) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.55s; }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           ============================================= */
        .title-slide {
            /* Radial glow in top-right corner */
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(240,165,0,0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(77,168,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-width: min(88vw, 860px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            background: var(--accent-amber-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            padding: 0.18em 0.65em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .arxiv-ref {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .title-slide h1 .amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .title-tagline {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.65;
            max-width: 62ch;
        }
        .title-chips {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .chip {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.72rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.2em 0.7em;
        }
        /* Decorative vertical lines on right */
        .title-deco {
            position: absolute;
            right: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            opacity: 0.18;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .deco-v { width: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--accent-amber), transparent); }
        .deco-v:nth-child(1) { height: clamp(4rem, 12vh, 9rem); }
        .deco-v:nth-child(2) { height: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 4.5rem); }
        .deco-v:nth-child(3) { height: clamp(3rem, 9vh, 7rem); }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM
           ============================================= */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .prob-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vh, 0.55rem);
        }
        .prob-card.bad  { border-color: rgba(248,113,113,0.28); background: rgba(248,113,113,0.04); }
        .prob-card.good { border-color: rgba(57,211,83,0.28);  background: rgba(57,211,83,0.04); }
        .prob-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.09em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .prob-card.bad  .prob-label { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .prob-card.good .prob-label { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .prob-card h3 { font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.7vw, 1.15rem); }
        .prob-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.22rem, 0.6vh, 0.42rem);
        }
        .prob-list li {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1.1vw, 0.82rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
            padding-left: 1.1em;
            position: relative;
        }
        .prob-list li::before { content: '→'; position: absolute; left: 0; opacity: 0.55; }
        .prob-card.bad  .prob-list li::before { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .prob-card.good .prob-list li::before { color: var(--accent-green); }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM
           ============================================= */
        .arch-content { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem); }

        /* Main pipeline row */
        .arch-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(96%, 1080px);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .arch-node {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            gap: clamp(0.15rem, 0.4vh, 0.3rem);
        }
        .arch-node.primary {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: var(--accent-amber-dim);
        }
        .arch-node-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.15vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .arch-node-sub {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.8vw, 0.62rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        /* Arrow between stages */
        .arch-arrow-col {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vw, 0.4rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .arch-arrow-col svg { width: clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px); height: auto; }

        /* Evolver box — wider, contains sub-stages */
        .evolver-node {
            flex: 1.6;
            background: rgba(77,168,255,0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(77,168,255,0.22);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.45rem, 1.1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .evolver-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.75vw, 0.62rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .evolver-stages-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.15rem, 0.4vh, 0.28rem);
            width: 100%;
        }
        .evolver-stage-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.45em;
            background: rgba(77,168,255,0.09);
            border: 1px solid rgba(77,168,255,0.18);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: clamp(0.18rem, 0.45vh, 0.3rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.5rem);
        }
        .evolver-stage-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.48rem, 0.68vw, 0.58rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            min-width: 1.4em;
        }
        .evolver-stage-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.78vw, 0.64rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* Loop-back line beneath the diagram */
        .arch-loopback {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(96%, 1080px);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        .loop-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            opacity: 0.3;
        }
        .loop-line.l { background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--accent-blue)); }
        .loop-line.r { background: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, var(--accent-blue)); }
        .loop-text {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.72vw, 0.6rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding: 0 0.6em;
            white-space: nowrap;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        /* Verification callout */
        .verif-note {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.38rem, 0.9vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.95vw, 0.74rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .verif-note strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDE 4: EVOLVER PIPELINE DETAIL
           ============================================= */
        .pipeline-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.55rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.35rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .pipe-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.28rem, 0.7vh, 0.52rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .pipe-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            width: 3px; height: 100%;
            background: var(--pipe-accent, var(--accent-amber));
        }
        .pipe-card:nth-child(1) { --pipe-accent: #f0a500; }
        .pipe-card:nth-child(2) { --pipe-accent: #4da8ff; }
        .pipe-card:nth-child(3) { --pipe-accent: #39d353; }
        .pipe-big-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.2vw, 2.4rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--pipe-accent, var(--accent-amber));
            opacity: 0.22;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .pipe-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 1.7vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .pipe-desc {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.62rem, 1.05vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .pipe-note {
            margin-top: auto;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.85vw, 0.7rem);
            color: var(--pipe-accent, var(--accent-amber));
            opacity: 0.75;
            font-style: italic;
        }
        .insight-box {
            background: var(--accent-blue-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(77,168,255,0.2);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.42rem, 1vh, 0.7rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.78rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .insight-box strong { color: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDE 5: CROSS-USER AGGREGATION
           ============================================= */
        .systems-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.28rem, 0.6vw, 0.45rem);
            margin: clamp(0.25rem, 0.7vh, 0.5rem) 0;
        }
        .sys-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.9vw, 0.72rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            padding: 0.18em 0.65em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .agg-points {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.38rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .agg-points li {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.68rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.52;
            padding-left: 1.6em;
            position: relative;
        }
        .agg-points li::before {
            content: '//';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .agg-points li strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .callout {
            background: var(--accent-amber-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.42rem, 1vh, 0.7rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.78rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .callout strong { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        /* =============================================
           SLIDES 6 & 7: CASE STUDY TABLES
           ============================================= */
        .case-content { gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.9vh, 0.7rem); }

        .case-meta-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .case-stat {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.95vw, 0.76rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .case-stat .v { font-weight: 600; }

        /* Evolution log table */
        .evo-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }
        .evo-table thead tr {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();

                // Reveal first slide immediately
                if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(this.navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            // Add .visible to trigger CSS animations
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.55 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0, startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 45) {
                        this.goToSlide(dy > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let last = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - last < 750) return;
                    last = now;
                    this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                    ? (idx / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                    : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            updateDots(idx) {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

</body>
</html>

    <style>
        /* =============================================
           THEME: Deep Navy + Amber Gold
           Research-forward, IDE-meets-academic aesthetic
           Inspired by JetBrains darcula + NeurIPS posters
           ============================================= */
        :root {

            --accent-blue-dim: rgba(77, 168, 255, 0.09);
            --accent-green:    #39d353;
            --accent-red:      #f87171;
            --border:          rgba(255,255,255,0.07);

            --font-display:    'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:       'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

            --ease-out-expo:   cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

            /* === VIEWPORT BASE: Typography scaling (viewport-base.css) === */
            --title-size:   clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size:      clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);

            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap:  clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap:  clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

        /* =============================================
           VIEWPORT BASE CSS (viewport-base.css — full)
           ============================================= */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;           /* CRITICAL */

            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;

        /* ALL typography uses clamp() */
        .card, .container, .content-box {

            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));

        /* Breakpoints: 700px, 600px, 500px */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);

        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {

           ANIMATIONS

        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(2) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.20s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(3) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.30s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(4) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.40s; }
        .slide.visible .stagger-child:nth-child(5) { opacity:1; transform:none; transition-delay:0.50s; }

        /* =============================================

           ============================================= */
        .arch-content { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem); }

        .arch-row {

        }
        .arch-node-title {

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();

                // Reveal first slide immediately
                if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(this.navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            // Add .visible to trigger CSS animations
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.55 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft': case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0, startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 45) {
                        this.goToSlide(dy > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let last = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - last < 750) return;
                    last = now;
                    this.goToSlide(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.currentSlide + 1 : this.currentSlide - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                    ? (idx / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                    : 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            updateDots(idx) {
                this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Convert a single-file HTML presentation into a PPTX deck.
3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).
10	
11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""
14	
15	import argparse
16	import os
17	import http.server
18	import subprocess
19	import sys
20	import tempfile
21	import threading
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from PIL import Image
25	from pptx import Presentation
26	from pptx.util import Emu
27	
28	
29	# CSS selectors to count slides, tried in order
30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""
85	
86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs
167	
168	
169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))
189	
190	
191	def main():
192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():
203	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input HTML not found: {html_path}")
204	
205	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="slides_") as tmp:
206	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp)
207	        print(f"Capturing slides from {html_path} ...")
208	        images = screenshot_slides(html_path, tmp_dir, args.width, args.height)
209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
210	        assemble_pptx(images, output_path)
211	        print(f"Done → {output_path}")
212	
213	
214	if __name__ == "__main__":
215	    main()
